content: Twitch EventSub webhook signature: HMAC-SHA256 over Twitch-Eventsub-Message-Id + Twitch-Eventsub-Message-Timestamp + RAW request body (concatenated, in that order) using the subscription secret (10-100 ASCII chars). Must verify against the untouched raw body (re-serializing JSON breaks the signature), compare with constant-time comparison (e.g. hmac.compare_digest), and reject timestamps older than 10 minutes to block replay.
